response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled full-stack and DLang developer, but he lacks the mandatory 5 to 10 years of C++ experience on Windows required for this position. His brief exposure to the capital markets domain at RIDE Capital utilized a Node.js/TypeScript stack rather than C++, making him unsuitable for a senior-level fixed-income C++ role.
strengths: Extensive software engineering background with over 10 years of experience in diverse tech stacks.
Proven expertise in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and test-driven development (TDD).
Possesses some capital markets domain knowledge from his tenure at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Severely lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, listing only a brief 7-month stint in 2014-2015.
No demonstrated experience with C++ on Windows platforms or enterprise SQL Server/Oracle databases.
Lacks specialized knowledge in Fixed Income or Fixed Income Derivatives.
